questions.source_content:
OFFICIAL NOTICE
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Jhalawar
Date: 3 November 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/237)
Subject: Quarterly Inspection of Departmental Vehicle Logbooks and Fuel Consumption Registers (Phase-2)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jhalawar division are hereby informed that under 'Quarterly Inspection of Departmental Vehicle Logbooks and Fuel Consumption Registers', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 8 November in the central compliance wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #337) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jhalawar, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and compliance movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jhalawar), 2. Budget Reconciliation #147, 3. Digital Indexing.
Deputy Director (Administration)
Lokesh Saini
solution_steps: 2. Apply First Line Indent (1.0") and Font 'Georgia'.
